transcript.text: Alright, let's get started. As we all know, we're planning to move production build artifacts from the legacy registry to the new OCI registry during the July 12 maintenance window. The new registry has passed its upload, download, and restore tests with the standard build pipelines, which is good. Before I approve the migration operating plan, I need to hear from each of you on any operational requirements or concerns. Developer platform, compliance, infrastructure — what do you need from me or from each other to make this migration go smoothly?

transcript.text: I need to flag a serious issue. While testing an unrelated build-plugin change yesterday, I found that 14 production repositories still pull from the legacy registry through hardcoded URLs and cannot be updated before July 12. They require a compatibility proxy and dual-write period. I have not updated the migration document yet with this finding.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I have a compliance requirement to flag. This morning I confirmed that signed release artifacts must be retained for exactly 180 days under our current audit control, and the retained copies must be immutable. I confirmed this while reviewing an audit sample, but I have not attached the control evidence to the migration ticket yet. We need to make sure the new OCI registry can enforce immutability on retained artifacts and that the migration plan accounts for the 180-day retention window before we proceed.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to flag an infrastructure concern. During a separate capacity exercise, I measured the cross-region transfer path and confirmed that transfers above exactly 2 terabytes per day trigger a sharply higher egress charge. The migration must therefore use same-region sources and a 2-terabyte-per-day transfer cap. I have not added those limits to the runbook yet, so we need to incorporate them before the plan is approved.

Thank you all for surfacing these issues. Let me summarize what I'm hearing and lay out the decisions I'm prepared to make.

First, Riley — 14 production repositories with hardcoded legacy registry URLs that can't be updated before July 12. That means we need a compatibility proxy so those repos can continue pulling after the migration, and we need a dual-write period so artifacts are written to both registries simultaneously until those repos are updated. Riley, I need you to update the migration document with this finding today, and I need a concrete timeline for when those 14 repos can be migrated off the hardcoded URLs.

Second, Casey — 180-day immutable retention for signed release artifacts. The new OCI registry must enforce immutability on retained artifacts, and the migration plan needs to account for the full 180-day retention window. Casey, please attach the control evidence to the migration ticket before I sign off.

Third, Drew — cross-region transfers above 2 terabytes per day trigger sharply higher egress charges. We'll mandate same-region sources only and a 2-terabyte-per-day transfer cap. Drew, add those limits to the runbook before approval.

If all three of you commit to updating your respective documents — the migration document, the compliance ticket, and the runbook — with these requirements, I'm prepared to approve the plan with the following decisions: dual-write enabled, legacy compatibility proxy enabled, 180-day artifact retention with immutability enforced, same-region sources only, and a 2 TB/day transfer cap. Can each of you confirm you'll have those updates in before July 12?
